rationale: The trajectory records a successful cloudflare-go upgrade to v0.55.0 followed by compilation errors and investigation without a completed API adaptation. The final verifier reproduces removed Workers KV methods and incompatible namespace signatures, preventing tests from executing. Although this also reflects an incomplete migration, the concrete source compiler diagnostics make compile-namespace-inconsistency the more specific primary category.
